verdict.summary: The change consistently applies rust-cache's main-only save guard to workflows that both run on branch refs and have a main-push path capable of reseeding the cache. The structural parser distinguishes PR/merge-group workflows, tag-only pushes, PR-only workflows, and unfiltered or explicitly main-filtered pushes; the expanded non-vacuity tests pin the intended scope and the existing step walker checks every discovered rust-cache use. The focused test suite passes (13 tests), and no correctness, security, or vacuity issue is evident in the diff.
